supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park launched Remote Desktop to DC-HD-01 and WS-LPARK-01 initiated a connection to the domain controller on port 3389 at 13:32 UTC.
Lucy Park also connected by Remote Desktop to FILE-HD-01; FILE-HD-01 recorded a successful interactive remote logon for her at 13:36 UTC.
These records establish Lucy's access to the domain controller shortly before the alerted time, but they do not establish that she created tmp.rwong.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records include no domain-controller account-management event or other record showing the creation of tmp.rwong, its creator, or its group memberships.
The supplied records do not establish whether domain-controller security and account-management telemetry was collected and complete for the alert window.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was actually created during the specified window, and the identity or logon session responsible.
Whether tmp.rwong was added only to Temp-Staff or granted other group membership or privileges.
Whether Lucy Park's RDP session to DC-HD-01 was authorized or was the session used for any account-management activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain DC-HD-01 Security and directory-service audit events for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including account creation, group membership changes, and relevant logon records; identify the actor and logon session.
Verify tmp.rwong's creation time, creator, enabled state, group memberships, and assigned privileges against directory records.
Confirm whether Lucy Park's RDP access to DC-HD-01 was authorized and correlate the DC-side session with any account-management events.
unrelated_findings: Slack was accessed from WS-LPARK-01 by Lucy Park around 13:41 UTC; this is outside the account-creation evidence and should be reviewed separately if relevant (T008-00040, T008-00041, T008-00042, T008-00043, T008-00047).
